test_title: PYST 05: SSC Stenographer - English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 11 Dec 2024 - Shift 2)
subject: english
question: Select the sentence that requires the article ‘the’.

options.text: She has an abundance of cake at home.
She is ignorant of her social standing.
They share rent of house equally.
He lives somewhere in southern Germany.

solution:
The correct answer is Option 3.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In sentence **Option 3**, the phrase "*rent of house*" is incorrect. The correct usage requires the article **'the'** before "*house*" to specify a particular house.
 
• The correct sentence should be: **"They share rent of the house equally."**
 
• Articles are used to define whether something is specific (**'the'**) or general (**'a'/'an'**).
 
• In this case, **'the'** is required as we are talking about a particular house whose rent is being shared.

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

Correct sentence: *They share rent of the house equally.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** "She has an abundance of cake at home." - No article needed as "cake" is uncountable.
 
• **Option 2:** "She is ignorant of her social standing." - No article needed before "social standing."
 
• **Option 4:** "He lives somewhere in southern Germany." - No article needed before "southern Germany" as geographical regions don't always take 'the'.
